Overview

Kuldīga is a city in Kuldīga with a population of 11,000. A picturesque town in western Latvia, known for Europe’s widest waterfall (Venta Rapid), a charming 17th-century old town, and the historic brick bridge. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
